The implementation is complete and all tests pass. Here's a summary of what I built:

## `/app/submission/main.py` (30 KB, single file, stdlib only)

**Envelope validation (exit 2, no stdout):** strict JSON via a custom `object_pairs_hook` (duplicate keys at every level rejected), `parse_constant`/`parse_float` hooks (rejects NaN/Infinity and any fractional/exponent number so only true integers survive; booleans excluded), strict UTF-8 decode (rejects BOM/malformed UTF-8), plus complete structural checks of `config`/`events` (alias canonicality + global uniqueness, anonymous-URI ban, peer modes, ttl/capacity ranges, nondecreasing `t`, known IDs, relay `auth` must be null, per-event hex length and the 8 MB total wire budget).

**URI language:** SIP/SIPS with one-shot percent decoding into the restricted user alphabet (1–64 chars), DNS-style hosts (≥2 labels, ≤253 chars, label/final-label rules, lowercased), optional 1–5 digit ports normalized to an integer (omitted ≠ explicit), and `tel:` with the four visual separators removed.

**Request syntax:** CRLF-only header block with byte/size/line-count bounds, exact `METHOD SP URI SP SIP/2.0` start line, generic header grammar with folding (continuation joined with one SP), compact names `f/t/i/l`, required-singleton detection, and exact Content-Length matching.

**Field grammar:** From (one address + exactly one `;tag=TOKEN`), To (single SIP/SIPS address canonical-equal to the target), Call-ID, CSeq, PAI/PPI (comma splitting outside quotes/brackets, one SIP + one tel, SIP-first ordering), Privacy (`id`/`none`/`absent`).

**Policy & ledger:** registry-only alias equality; access (PAI discarded, PPI ownership) vs relay (PAI required, single owner in the peer allow-list); From must be an account alias or the anonymous URI with `id`; outgoing projection with external-egress PAI stripping; exactly-once ledger keyed by `(peer, call-id, cseq, method)` with TTL expiry before every event, conflict detection, and global capacity eviction by oldest insertion index — all in O(1) amortized time (1.4 s for a 16 MB / 10 000-event envelope).

Verification: the public example passes, plus ~200 hand-written spec-conformance cases (every rejection stage, canonicalization, policy, ledger, expiry/eviction/conflict) and two fuzzers (700 randomized envelopes) with zero crashes or protocol violations.
